```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 11, fig.height = 6)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

package.list <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "stringr", "DT", "plotly", "here", "htmltools")
packageLoad <- function(packages) {
  for (package in packages) {
    if (!require(package, character.only = TRUE)) {
      install.packages(package, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
      library(package, character.only = TRUE)
    }
  }
}
packageLoad(package.list)

setwd(here::here())
source(here::here("Code", "file-merger.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
dat <- returnAllFiles(d = directory, export = TRUE)
names(dat) <- tolower(names(dat))

required_columns <- c("sample.id", "analyte", "result", "units", "collected",
                      "location.name", "treatment.name", "event.type")
missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(dat))
if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop("Water report is missing required columns: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
}

safe_as_date <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(x)
  if (inherits(x, c("POSIXct", "POSIXlt"))) return(as.Date(x))

  date_text <- stringr::str_squish(as.character(x))
  date_text[is.na(x) | date_text == ""] <- NA_character_
  parsed <- rep(as.Date(NA), length(date_text))
  accepted_formats <- c(
    "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%d",
    "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S", "%m/%d/%Y",
    "%m/%d/%y %H:%M:%S", "%m/%d/%y"
  )

  for (date_format in accepted_formats) {
    pending <- is.na(parsed) & !is.na(date_text)
    if (!any(pending)) break
    parsed[pending] <- suppressWarnings(
      as.Date(date_text[pending], format = date_format)
    )
  }
  parsed
}

lab_qc_labels <- c("Lab Blank", "Method Blank", "Lab Control Sample")

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(sample.id, analyte, units, location.name, treatment.name, event.type),
           ~ na_if(stringr::str_squish(as.character(.x)), "")),
    collected_date = safe_as_date(collected),
    is_duplicate = coalesce(stringr::str_detect(sample.id, "-D$"), FALSE),
    primary_sample_id = stringr::str_remove(sample.id, "-D$"),
    is_lab_qc =
      coalesce(stringr::str_detect(sample.id, regex("^BK(?:-|$)", ignore_case = TRUE)), FALSE) |
      location.name %in% lab_qc_labels |
      treatment.name %in% lab_qc_labels |
      event.type %in% lab_qc_labels
  )

sample_inventory <- dat %>%
  distinct(sample.id, primary_sample_id, is_duplicate, location.name,
           treatment.name, event.type, collected_date, is_lab_qc)

actual_sample_inventory <- sample_inventory %>%
  filter(!is_lab_qc)

actual_samples <- dat %>%
  filter(!is_lab_qc)

pair_status <- actual_sample_inventory %>%
  filter(!is.na(primary_sample_id)) %>%
  group_by(primary_sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    has_primary = any(!is_duplicate),
    has_duplicate = any(is_duplicate),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

valid_collection_dates <- actual_sample_inventory$collected_date[
  !is.na(actual_sample_inventory$collected_date)
]
if (length(valid_collection_dates) > 0) {
  report_years <- sort(unique(format(valid_collection_dates, "%Y")))
  priority_year <- max(as.integer(report_years), na.rm = TRUE)
  date_min <- min(valid_collection_dates)
  date_max <- max(valid_collection_dates)
  date_range_text <- paste(
    format(date_min, "%Y-%m-%d"), "through", format(date_max, "%Y-%m-%d")
  )
} else {
  report_years <- character(0)
  priority_year <- as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"))
  date_min <- as.Date(NA)
  date_max <- as.Date(NA)
  date_range_text <- "[No valid collection dates available]"
}

dt_options <- list(
  pageLength = 15,
  scrollX = TRUE,
  autoWidth = TRUE,
  dom = "Bfrtip",
  buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel")
)

site_plot <- function(site_data) {
  plot_data <- site_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(analyte), !is.na(result), !is.na(collected_date)) %>%
    mutate(treatment_plot = coalesce(treatment.name, "[Missing treatment]"))

  analytes <- sort(unique(plot_data$analyte))
  if (length(analytes) == 0) return(htmltools::p("No plottable results for this site."))

  treatments <- sort(unique(plot_data$treatment_plot))
  treatment_colors <- setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(length(treatments), "Dark 3"), treatments)
  p <- plotly::plot_ly(height = 700)
  trace_analytes <- character(0)

  for (analyte_value in analytes) {
    analyte_data <- plot_data %>% filter(analyte == analyte_value)
    for (treatment_value in sort(unique(analyte_data$treatment_plot))) {
      trace_data <- analyte_data %>% filter(treatment_plot == treatment_value)
      p <- plotly::add_markers(
        p, data = trace_data,
        x = ~collected_date, y = ~result,
        name = treatment_value,
        legendgroup = treatment_value,
        marker = list(color = treatment_colors[[treatment_value]], size = 8),
        text = ~paste0(
          "Sample ID: ", sample.id,
          "<br>Treatment: ", treatment_plot,
          "<br>Event type: ", coalesce(event.type, "[Missing]"),
          "<br>Date: ", collected_date,
          "<br>Result: ", result, " ", coalesce(units, "")
        ),
        hoverinfo = "text",
        visible = identical(analyte_value, analytes[[1]])
      )
      trace_analytes <- c(trace_analytes, analyte_value)
    }
  }

  units_by_analyte <- vapply(analytes, function(a) {
    values <- sort(unique(na.omit(plot_data$units[plot_data$analyte == a])))
    if (length(values) == 0) "" else paste(values, collapse = ", ")
  }, character(1))

  buttons <- lapply(seq_along(analytes), function(i) {
    analyte_value <- analytes[[i]]
    y_title <- if (nzchar(units_by_analyte[[i]])) {
      paste0("Result (", units_by_analyte[[i]], ")")
    } else {
      "Result"
    }
    list(
      method = "update",
      args = list(
        list(visible = trace_analytes == analyte_value),
        list(title = analyte_value, yaxis = list(title = y_title))
      ),
      label = analyte_value
    )
  })

  initial_y_title <- if (nzchar(units_by_analyte[[1]])) {
    paste0("Result (", units_by_analyte[[1]], ")")
  } else {
    "Result"
  }

  plotly::layout(
    p,
    title = analytes[[1]],
    xaxis = list(title = "Collection date"),
    yaxis = list(title = initial_y_title),
    hovermode = "closest",
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2),
    margin = list(t = 100, b = 110),
    updatemenus = list(list(
      type = "dropdown", buttons = buttons,
      x = 0, xanchor = "left", y = 1.16, yanchor = "top",
      direction = "down", showactive = TRUE
    ))
  )
}
```

# Overview

This report covers collection dates from `r date_range_text`. Counts are
calculated from distinct sample IDs, not analyte result rows. Laboratory blanks,
method blanks, and laboratory control samples are excluded from all actual-sample
counts and summaries, but remain available in the quality-control and raw-data
sections. A duplicate is an ID ending in `-D`; its primary ID is the same ID with
only that terminal suffix removed.

```{r overview-cards, results='asis'}
overview <- list(
  "Sites" = n_distinct(na.omit(actual_sample_inventory$location.name)),
  "Collection events" = n_distinct(na.omit(actual_sample_inventory$collected_date)),
  "Actual sample IDs" = n_distinct(na.omit(actual_sample_inventory$sample.id)),
  "Primary sample IDs" = n_distinct(na.omit(actual_sample_inventory$sample.id[!actual_sample_inventory$is_duplicate])),
  "Duplicate IDs" = n_distinct(na.omit(actual_sample_inventory$sample.id[actual_sample_inventory$is_duplicate])),
  "Matched duplicate pairs" = sum(pair_status$has_primary & pair_status$has_duplicate),
  "Lab QC IDs excluded" = n_distinct(na.omit(sample_inventory$sample.id[sample_inventory$is_lab_qc]))
)
cat('<div class="status-grid">')
for (label in names(overview)) {
  cat(sprintf('<div class="status-card"><div class="status-value">%s</div><div class="status-label">%s</div></div>',
              format(overview[[label]], big.mark = ","), label))
}
cat('</div>')
```

Primary IDs without a matched duplicate: **`r sum(pair_status$has_primary & !pair_status$has_duplicate)`**.
This is informational; a duplicate is not expected for every primary sample.

# Sampling priorities

The AWQP growing-season target is at least **three sampling events per
location–treatment pair**. The table below highlights observed pairs that have
not yet reached that target in **`r priority_year`**. An event is one distinct
collection date, so duplicate bottles and multiple analyte results do not
inflate this count.

<div class="alert alert-warning" role="alert">
<strong>Before scheduling additional field collection:</strong> Check ongoing
analysis in the <a href="https://webtrieveus.alsenviro.com/Login.aspx"
target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">ALS Webtrieve portal</a>. Recently
submitted samples may still be under analysis and therefore absent from this
report's completed ALS results.
</div>

```{r sampling-priorities}
sampling_target <- 3L

priority_table <- sample_inventory %>%
  filter(
    !is_lab_qc,
    !is.na(collected_date),
    as.integer(format(collected_date, "%Y")) == priority_year,
    !is.na(location.name),
    !is.na(treatment.name)
  ) %>%
  group_by(location.name, treatment.name) %>%
  summarise(
    samples_collected = n_distinct(collected_date),
    samples_still_needed = pmax(sampling_target - samples_collected, 0L),
    collection_dates = paste(
      sort(unique(format(collected_date, "%Y-%m-%d"))),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(samples_collected < sampling_target) %>%
  arrange(desc(samples_still_needed), location.name, treatment.name)

if (length(valid_collection_dates) == 0) {
  htmltools::div(
    class = "alert alert-warning",
    "Sampling priorities could not be calculated because no valid collection dates were found."
  )
} else if (nrow(priority_table) == 0) {
  htmltools::div(
    class = "alert alert-success",
    paste("All observed location–treatment pairs have at least", sampling_target,
          "sampling events in", priority_year, ".")
  )
} else {
  DT::datatable(
    priority_table,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    caption = paste(
      "Location–treatment pairs below the",
      sampling_target,
      "event target for",
      priority_year
    ),
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = modifyList(
      dt_options,
      list(
        pageLength = 25,
        order = list(list(2, "desc"), list(0, "asc")),
        columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-center", targets = c(2, 3)))
      )
    )
  ) %>%
    DT::formatStyle(
      "samples_still_needed",
      backgroundColor = DT::styleInterval(c(1, 2), c("#fff3cd", "#f8d7da", "#dc3545")),
      color = DT::styleInterval(2, c("#212529", "#ffffff")),
      fontWeight = "bold"
    )
}
```

This table can only evaluate location–treatment pairs represented by at least
one sample in the current report. Planned pairs with **zero** samples require a
separate sampling-plan reference and will not appear here.

# Sampling coverage

An event is a distinct collection date for a location/treatment combination.
The bottle columns separately show distinct primary and duplicate sample IDs.

```{r coverage-table}
coverage <- actual_sample_inventory %>%
  mutate(
    location.name = coalesce(location.name, "[Missing location]"),
    treatment.name = coalesce(treatment.name, "[Missing treatment]")
  ) %>%
  group_by(location.name, treatment.name) %>%
  summarise(
    events = n_distinct(collected_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    primary_sample_ids = n_distinct(sample.id[!is_duplicate], na.rm = TRUE),
    duplicate_ids = n_distinct(sample.id[is_duplicate], na.rm = TRUE),
    collection_dates = paste(sort(unique(format(collected_date[!is.na(collected_date)], "%Y-%m-%d"))), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(location.name, treatment.name)

DT::datatable(
  coverage,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  caption = "Sampling coverage by location and treatment",
  extensions = "Buttons",
  options = dt_options
)
```

# Explore WQ data

Use the site dropdown to show its treatment/event summary and results. Within
each plot, use the analyte dropdown above the graph. Points are colored by
treatment.

```{r site-panels}
sites <- sort(unique(na.omit(actual_samples$location.name)))
site_menu <- vector("list", length(sites))
site_panels <- vector("list", length(sites))

for (i in seq_along(sites)) {
  site <- sites[[i]]
  site_data <- actual_samples %>% filter(location.name == site)
  site_coverage <- coverage %>% filter(location.name == site) %>% select(-location.name)
  panel_id <- paste0("water-site-", i)

  site_menu[[i]] <- htmltools::tags$li(
    htmltools::tags$a(href = paste0("#", panel_id), `data-toggle` = "tab", site)
  )
  site_panels[[i]] <- htmltools::tags$div(
    id = panel_id,
    class = paste("tab-pane", if (i == 1) "active" else ""),
    htmltools::tags$h3(site),
    DT::datatable(
    site_coverage,
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = paste("Sampling status:", site),
    options = list(dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE)
    ),
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "site-plot-container",
      site_plot(site_data)
    )
  )
}

htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "site-selector-callout",
    htmltools::tags$p(class = "selector-label", "Select a site to view its sampling status and water-quality results:"),
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "dropdown",
      htmltools::tags$button(
        class = "btn btn-success btn-lg dropdown-toggle",
        type = "button", `data-toggle` = "dropdown", `aria-haspopup` = "true",
        `aria-expanded` = "false",
        "Choose a site to explore ", htmltools::tags$span(class = "caret")
      ),
      htmltools::tags$ul(class = "dropdown-menu", site_menu)
    )
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(class = "tab-content", site_panels)
)
```

# Quality control

## Missing or unmapped fields

This table flags missing or unmapped fields needed by the report. Use the CSV or
Excel button to export the currently filtered error report. Laboratory QC records
are retained here so problems in those records remain visible.

```{r qc-report}
qc_source <- dat %>%
  distinct(sample.id, lab.id.x, location.name, treatment.name, event.type,
           collected_date, analyte, method)

qc_report <- bind_rows(
  qc_source %>% filter(is.na(sample.id)) %>% mutate(issue = "Missing sample ID"),
  qc_source %>% filter(is.na(location.name)) %>% mutate(issue = "Missing/unmapped location"),
  qc_source %>% filter(is.na(treatment.name)) %>% mutate(issue = "Missing/unmapped treatment"),
  qc_source %>% filter(is.na(collected_date)) %>% mutate(issue = "Missing/unparseable collection date"),
  qc_source %>% filter(is.na(analyte)) %>% mutate(issue = "Missing analyte"),
  qc_source %>% filter(is.na(method)) %>% mutate(issue = "Missing method")
) %>%
  group_by(sample.id, location.name, treatment.name, event.type, collected_date, analyte) %>%
  summarise(
    issue = paste(sort(unique(issue)), collapse = "; "),
    lab.id.x = {
      lab_ids <- sort(unique(na.omit(lab.id.x)))
      if (length(lab_ids) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(lab_ids, collapse = "; ")
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(sample.id, issue, lab.id.x, everything()) %>%
  arrange(issue, sample.id)

if (nrow(qc_report) == 0) {
  htmltools::div(class = "alert alert-success", "No missing or unmapped required fields were found. Hooray!")
} else {
  DT::datatable(
    qc_report,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    caption = paste(nrow(qc_report), "sample/analyte records require review"),
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = dt_options
  )
}
```

## Duplicate pairings

This developer-facing table has one row per normalized, non-laboratory-QC sample
ID. It pairs each primary ID with the corresponding terminal-`-D` ID when one is
present. A missing duplicate is informational because a duplicate is not expected
for every primary sample. Use the column filters or the Copy, CSV, and Excel
buttons to investigate individual records.

<!-- Developer-facing duplicate audit: comment out this section if it is no longer needed. -->

```{r duplicate-pairings}
collapse_text <- function(x) {
  values <- sort(unique(na.omit(as.character(x))))
  if (length(values) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(values, collapse = "; ")
}

collapse_dates <- function(x) {
  values <- sort(unique(x[!is.na(x)]))
  if (length(values) == 0) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    paste(format(values, "%Y-%m-%d"), collapse = "; ")
  }
}

duplicate_pairings <- actual_sample_inventory %>%
  filter(!is.na(primary_sample_id)) %>%
  group_by(primary_sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    observed_primary_sample_id = collapse_text(sample.id[!is_duplicate]),
    duplicate_sample_id = collapse_text(sample.id[is_duplicate]),
    has_primary = any(!is_duplicate),
    has_duplicate = any(is_duplicate),
    primary_collected_date = collapse_dates(collected_date[!is_duplicate]),
    duplicate_collected_date = collapse_dates(collected_date[is_duplicate]),
    primary_date_count = n_distinct(collected_date[!is_duplicate], na.rm = TRUE),
    duplicate_date_count = n_distinct(collected_date[is_duplicate], na.rm = TRUE),
    all_date_count = n_distinct(collected_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    location.name = collapse_text(location.name),
    treatment.name = collapse_text(treatment.name),
    event.type = collapse_text(event.type),
    location_count = n_distinct(location.name, na.rm = TRUE),
    treatment_count = n_distinct(treatment.name, na.rm = TRUE),
    event_type_count = n_distinct(event.type, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pairing_status = case_when(
      has_primary & has_duplicate ~ "Matched pair",
      has_primary ~ "Primary only",
      has_duplicate ~ "Duplicate present; primary missing",
      TRUE ~ "No usable ID"
    )
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    qc_notes = {
      notes <- character(0)
      if (!has_primary) notes <- c(notes, "Primary sample ID was not found")
      if (all_date_count == 0) notes <- c(notes, "Collection date was not found")
      if (primary_date_count > 1) notes <- c(notes, "Primary ID has multiple collection dates")
      if (duplicate_date_count > 1) notes <- c(notes, "Duplicate ID has multiple collection dates")
      if (has_primary && has_duplicate &&
          !is.na(primary_collected_date) && !is.na(duplicate_collected_date) &&
          primary_collected_date != duplicate_collected_date) {
        notes <- c(notes, "Primary and duplicate collection dates differ")
      }
      if (location_count > 1) notes <- c(notes, "Multiple locations are mapped to this pair")
      if (treatment_count > 1) notes <- c(notes, "Multiple treatments are mapped to this pair")
      if (event_type_count > 1) notes <- c(notes, "Multiple event types are mapped to this pair")
      if (length(notes) == 0) "" else paste(notes, collapse = "; ")
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(pairing_status == "Duplicate present; primary missing"),
          desc(nzchar(qc_notes)), primary_sample_id)

pair_issue_count <- sum(nzchar(duplicate_pairings$qc_notes))
missing_date_count <- sum(duplicate_pairings$all_date_count == 0)
missing_primary_count <- sum(!duplicate_pairings$has_primary)
date_mismatch_count <- sum(
  duplicate_pairings$has_primary & duplicate_pairings$has_duplicate &
  !is.na(duplicate_pairings$primary_collected_date) &
  !is.na(duplicate_pairings$duplicate_collected_date) &
  duplicate_pairings$primary_collected_date != duplicate_pairings$duplicate_collected_date
)

if (pair_issue_count > 0) {
  htmltools::div(
    class = "alert alert-warning",
    htmltools::tags$strong(paste(pair_issue_count, "duplicate-pairing rows require review.")),
    paste(
      "Missing primary IDs:", missing_primary_count,
      "| Missing collection dates:", missing_date_count,
      "| Primary/duplicate date mismatches:", date_mismatch_count,
      "Filter the QC notes column below for sample-specific details."
    )
  )
} else {
  htmltools::div(
    class = "alert alert-success",
    "No missing dates, orphan duplicates, date mismatches, or conflicting pair metadata were found."
  )
}

duplicate_pairings_display <- duplicate_pairings %>%
  transmute(
    `Review flag` = if_else(nzchar(qc_notes), "Review", ""),
    `Primary sample ID` = observed_primary_sample_id,
    `Duplicate sample ID` = duplicate_sample_id,
    `Pairing status` = pairing_status,
    `Primary collection date` = primary_collected_date,
    `Duplicate collection date` = duplicate_collected_date,
    Location = location.name,
    Treatment = treatment.name,
    `Event type` = event.type,
    `QC notes` = qc_notes
  )

DT::datatable(
  duplicate_pairings_display,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  caption = "Primary and duplicate sample-ID pairing audit (laboratory QC excluded)",
  extensions = "Buttons",
  options = modifyList(
    dt_options,
    list(
      pageLength = 25,
      order = list(list(0, "desc"), list(1, "asc")),
      columnDefs = list(list(visible = FALSE, targets = 0))
    )
  )
) %>%
  DT::formatStyle(
    "Review flag",
    target = "row",
    backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual("Review", "#fff3cd")
  )
```

# Raw data

```{r raw-data}
DT::datatable(
  dat,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  extensions = "Buttons",
  options = modifyList(dt_options, list(pageLength = 25))
)
```
